alex: quick heads-up — ran lane-aware tiling heuristic sweep; odd perf split between A100 and H100
maria: paste config? :eyes:
alex: sure
alex: ```
# autotune config
kernel_picker:
  mode: lane-aware
  tiling: auto
  tile_size_candidates: [32, 64, 96, 128]
  warp_specialization: true
  reg_pressure_threshold: 0.75
batching:
  max_batch: 32
  dynamic_batching: true
  pref_kv_cache: enabled
force_register_allocation: unset
``` 
alex: perf summary (seq_len=256, batch=8):
alex: ```
A100: tokens/sec=1120, p50=42ms, p95=120ms
H100: tokens/sec=980, p50=50ms, p95=145ms
```
jordan: did you pin register allocation? h100 sometimes spills aggressively
alex: re-ran with `force_register_allocation: local` -> H100 tokens/sec=1250
maria: so regalloc/spill is the culprit. proposal: micro-autotune per device family and seq_len bucket instead of lots of hard rules
kevin: +1. run a cheap microbench sampling 3 candidates per device class and cache picks keyed by (model, device_family, seq_bucket)
alex: prototype flow: on cold start run microbench for seq buckets {64,128,256,512}, store winner for 24h, log reg_spill and l1_usage
maria: define seq buckets: <64,64-128,129-256,257-512,>512
alex: capturing these debug rows helped:
alex: ```
[profile] tile=96 warp_spec=1 regs=64 spill=0 l1_bytes=48k cycles=1.2e6
[profile] tile=128 warp_spec=0 regs=92 spill=8 l1_bytes=88k cycles=1.5e6
```
jordan: spill=8 explains H100 slowdown; A100 didn't spill on tile=128 so it was fine
kevin: implementation checklist:
- microbench on cold start
- pick per (model, device_family, seq_bucket)
- fallback policy if latency SLO violated
- metric `kernel_picker.choice` with tags model/device/seq_bucket and fields reg_spill,l1_usage,latency
maria: also persist spill/l1 counters so we can debug regressions; allow forced re-run after X hours
alex: I'll open a small PR with proto and a test that simulates reg spill; assigning to @maria for review
maria: ack, will review tomorrow :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy-preview: build/tiling-sweep-proto #842 started by alex
alex: thanks — will follow up with CI numbers and a short writeup
